adaptation.procedural: Deterministic CPU-seeded 3D noise lattice sampled with source Generated coordinates, scale/detail/lacunarity/roughness, linear ramps and exact WallDarken multiplier; not a pixel-exact Blender Perlin kernel.
adaptation.areaLights: Source poses and colours. DISK becomes equal-area rectangle; browser scene-radiance convention energyWatts / area, not a claim of measured lumens.
adaptation.shadow: Zero-intensity source-Key-direction shadow projector; stage materials read its shadow mask. No duplicate illuminating directional light.
adaptation.environment: PMREM captured from source-position stage geometry, source lamps and matched emissive cards, not an unrelated grey room.
adaptation.fog: Lightweight depth fog matched at an 18 m optical path; anisotropic volume scattering and Blender compositor are not reproduced exactly.
adaptation.glow: Local lamp glow planes replace full-frame Fog Glow; original PNG files are never altered.
adaptation.cloth: Stored evaluated final pose; hidden whenever introFrame is supplied, so the unchanged intro PNG owns the cloth.
